events.title: Pope Innocent IV arrives at Lyon, threatened by Frederick II
events.description: Threatened by Emperor Frederick II, Pope Innocent IV arrived at Lyon. Early the next year he summoned the bishops to the First Council of Lyon, at which he excommunicated Frederick and declared him deposed.

events.title: Wren's new St Paul's Cathedral holds its first service
events.description: The choir of Christopher Wren's new St Paul's opened for worship with a thanksgiving service for the Peace of Ryswick. The cathedral, replacing the one lost in the Great Fire, was declared complete in 1711.

events.title: The Touro Synagogue is dedicated in Newport, Rhode Island
events.description: The Jeshuat Israel congregation dedicated the Touro Synagogue in Newport, Rhode Island, designed by Peter Harrison and built from 1759 under the leadership of Isaac Touro. It is the oldest surviving synagogue building in the United States.

events.title: Napoleon crowns himself emperor at Notre-Dame
events.description: In the presence of Pope Pius VII, Napoleon placed the imperial crown on his own head and then crowned Josephine. The ceremony proclaimed a new hereditary monarchy born of the Revolution.
events.html: In the presence of Pope Pius VII, Napoleon placed the imperial crown on his own head and then crowned Josephine. The ceremony proclaimed a new hereditary monarchy born of the Revolution.

events.title: Napoleon defeats Austria and Russia at Austerlitz
events.description: On the first anniversary of his coronation, Napoleon routed a larger Austro-Russian army at Austerlitz in Moravia. The 'Battle of the Three Emperors' knocked Austria out of the Third Coalition.
events.html: On the first anniversary of his coronation, Napoleon routed a larger Austro-Russian army at Austerlitz in Moravia. The 'Battle of the Three Emperors' knocked Austria out of the Third Coalition.

events.title: A Filipino rearguard holds Tirad Pass to cover Aguinaldo's escape
events.description: In northern Luzon, a 60-man Filipino rearguard under Brigadier General Gregorio del Pilar was overcome by more than 500 Americans, but delayed their advance long enough for President Emilio Aguinaldo and his troops to escape.

events.title: Fermi's team achieves the first controlled nuclear chain reaction
events.description: Under the stands of Stagg Field at the University of Chicago, Enrico Fermi's team started a self-sustaining chain reaction in Chicago Pile-1. It opened the way to atomic bombs and nuclear power.

events.title: The United Arab Emirates is founded
events.description: Six of the Trucial States, led by Abu Dhabi and Dubai, formed the United Arab Emirates after Britain's withdrawal from the Gulf. Ras al-Khaimah joined in 1972.
